Srivastava, Advocate, PTL Shri Pankaj Prakash, PTL Powerlinks Transmission Limited (hereinafter referred to as “PTL”), a transmission licensee, filed three petitions for truing up of transmission tariff of the 2014-19 tariff period under the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2014 (hereinafter referred to as “the 2014 Tariff Regulations”) and for determination of tariff of the 2019-24 tariff period under the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2019 (hereinafter referred to as “the 2019 Tariff Regulations”) for six assets associated with Tala Hydro Electric Project in Eastern Region, East-North Interconnector and Northern Region Transmission System (hereinafter referred to as “the transmission system”). The details of the petitions and the assets covered in the petitions are as follows: Order in Petition Nos. 589/T/2020 and 590/TT/2020 Page 4 of 6 2. As per the first proviso to clause (1) of Regulation 8 of the 2019 Tariff Regulations, in case of transmission elements put into commercial operation before 1.4.2019, a transmission licensee is required to file a consolidated petition in respect of all the transmission elements covered in a transmission system for determination of tariff of the 2019-24 tariff period. Further, as per Regulation 9(2) of the 2019 Tariff Regulations, in case of existing transmission elements, the transmission licensee is required to file a combined petition for determination of tariff of the 2019-24 and truing up of the 2014-19 tariff period. As PTL filed three separate petitions for truing up of the tariff of the 201419 tariff period and determination of tariff of the 2019-24 tariff period for its transmission elements, which were put into commercial operation before 1.4.2019, covered in the transmission system, the Commission during the hearing on 28.8.2020 directed PTL to file a consolidated petition. 3. Accordingly, PTL has made a consolidated claim for truing up of the tariff of the 2014-19 tariff period and determination of tariff of the 2019-24 tariff period for the transmission elements covered under the instant transmission system by filing revised Order in Petition Nos. 589/T/2020 and 590/TT/2020 Page 5 of 6 tariff Forms in Petition No. 588/TT/2020. As a result, Petition No.589/TT/2020 and Petition No. 590/TT/2020 have become infructuous. 4. In view of the above, we dispose of Petition No.589/TT/2020 and Petition No. 590/TT/2020 as infructuous. sd/sd/sd/- **(Pravas Kumar Singh) (I. S. Jha) (P. K.
